description: This Java class implements a service for managing MobileAppBundle entities, including saving, updating OAuth2 clients, and deleting bundles, with logging and exception handling.

classes.name: DefaultTbMobileAppBundleService
classes.description: Service class for managing MobileAppBundle entities, including save, update OAuth2 clients, and delete operations with logging.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a MobileAppBundle, updates OAuth2 clients if provided, logs the action, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: updateOauth2Clients
methods.description: Updates OAuth2 clients for a MobileAppBundle, logs the update, and handles exceptions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a MobileAppBundle, logs the deletion, and handles exceptions.
